items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Yeah, well I remember him and this other band, what I used to listen to do on Saturday. They played in a different place, see. But I don't remember nobody else in that band either.

ctx.x: Well, a slide trombone is a tenor trombone. I used to study under Mineta, remember? Oh, yeah, yeah. I studied the slide trombone, which is a tenor, you know, it's that B-flat trombone. Yeah.

Who was playing that horn? Do you remember that? No, I don't know, I don't remember who was playing that horn. The only one I can remember playing the horn was that man Perez and the reason I remember him, because I was more interested in what he was doing than the balance of it. And what other bands did you remember around that time? Other bands, what I was supposed to play that time, well. This is before you started playing. Yeah, that was before I started playing. And I heard another one, I can remember the…
Oh man, I don't know. Well he used to use Peter Boccage, Richard Payne, Bonk, either Buddy or Yannick, I can't remember which. It must have been Buddy. I think Buddy was a better reader than Yannick.
